sections.title: Understanding Robot Color Perception
sections.body: In this section, we will explore how robots perceive color by averaging RGB vectors over time. This process helps robots to identify and differentiate colors in their environment, which is crucial for tasks like object recognition.

sections.title: Recognizing Curves with Neural Networks
sections.body: Next, we will discuss how curves on planar surfaces, such as lines and circles, can be recognized using neural networks. By extracting specific parameters from these curves, we can train models to classify different shapes effectively.

sections.title: Coordinate Transformations in Vision Systems
sections.body: We will then dive into the concept of camera coordinate transformations. This involves converting world coordinates to camera coordinates and then to image coordinates, which is essential for accurately mapping visual data.

sections.title: Mapping and Measuring in 3D Space
sections.body: Finally, we will look at how binocular vision systems measure 3D surfaces and calculate distances from points to planes. Understanding these measurements is vital for applications in robotics and computer vision.
